blocks.text: By submitting an Application, you confirm that all information provided is true and accurate to the best of your knowledge, and you agree that your Application Data may be shared with the respective internship programme coordinators and authorised Partners as described in our Privacy Policy.
6.1 Administrators

Authorised Admins may create and manage Internship listings, review Applications, update application status, modify Student data where necessary for processing, forward Applications to Partners, approve or reject Applications, and perform other operational functions required to run the Platform. 6.2 Partners

Partners are granted limited access to the Platform. Partners do not have access to a Student's complete profile or all personal data stored on the Platform. Partners may view only the Application form and related information necessary to assess eligibility for their respective Internship programmes.

Partners must use Application Data solely for recruitment and selection purposes, maintain confidentiality, and not disclose Student information to unauthorised third parties. Partner access may be revoked at {{operatorShortName}}'s discretion.
